remarks: Minutes to the village and an easy commute! This lovely Colonial offers all the spaces you've been hoping for with a freshly painted interior and recently redone driveway! Lots of updates throughout! Kitchen with stainless steel appliances and built-in hutch, open floor plan, inviting family room and sliders off the breakfast area that walk right out onto an over-sized outdoor deck and spacious, level yard. Two-story dramatic living room and sun-drenched dining room. High ceilings and great floor plan. Four finished levels with flexible spaces for whatever your heart desires: home offices, gym and/or playroom. Don't miss this opportunity to make New Canaan your new home!
